title: More with Less: Efficient Parallel Scientific Code Translation via an Agent-Skill Workflow
title_zh: 以少胜多：通过智能体-技能工作流高效翻译并行科学代码

paragraphs.en: 提出智能体-技能工作流框架，将科学代码翻译拆分为翻译、编译诊断和验证三个智能体，正确率更高且 token 减少过半。 Translating parallel scientific codes between HPC programming frameworks is a critical but labor-intensive task. Existing LLM-based approaches rely on fixed sequential pipelines with undifferentiated repair strategies and correctness criteria that do not match scientific computing practice. We present an agent-skill framework that separates translation, compilation diagnosis, and execution validation into three autonomous agents coordinated by a verdict-driven orchestrator, routing each failure to a targeted repair skill rather than retrying blindly. An automated output check drives the self-correction loop, complemented by an offline LLM-based verification that exposes false positives escaping compiler and runtime checks. We evaluate the framework on 30 HeCBench kernels translated bidirectionally among CUDA, OpenMP, and SYCL with three open-source LLMs. Our framework attains the higher verified correctness rate in all 18 model and direction combinations over a state-of-the-art baseline while consuming up to 52.4% fewer tokens, remaining consistent across models and directions without architectural modification.
paragraphs.zh: 提出智能体-技能工作流框架，将科学代码翻译拆分为翻译、编译诊断和验证三个智能体，正确率更高且 token 减少过半。在高性能计算（HPC）编程框架之间翻译并行科学代码是一项关键但耗时的任务。 现有基于大语言模型的方法依赖于固定的顺序流水线，采用无差别的修复策略，其正确性标准也与科学计算的实际需求不相符。 我们提出一个智能体-技能框架，将翻译、编译诊断和执行验证分离为三个自主智能体，由一个基于裁决的编排器进行协调，将每次失败路由到针对性的修复技能，而不是盲目重试。 自动化的输出检查驱动自我纠正循环，并由离线的基于大语言模型的验证加以补充，以暴露逃过编译器和运行时检查的假阳性结果。 我们在 30 个 HeCBench 内核上对该框架进行评估，使用三个开源大语言模型在 CUDA、OpenMP 和 SYCL 之间进行双向翻译。 在全部 18 种模型与方向组合中，我们的框架均取得了比最先进基线更高的经验证正确率，同时 token 消耗最多减少 52.4%，且无需修改架构即可在不同模型和方向上保持一致表现。
